banner.title: ntfy
banner.tagline: Publishes and delivers push notifications over plain HTTP, with a message cache, attachments and a user store on one claim.

art.about: an HTTP publish and subscribe server that pushes notifications to phones and browsers
art.title: How ntfy delivers a message

explainer.title: A POST to a topic becomes a push

steps.title: Config
steps.text: ConfigMap ntfy-config mounts server.yml at /etc/ntfy/server.yml. It sets the base URL, the cache, attachment limits and the upstream relay.

steps.title: Publish
steps.text: A client POSTs to a topic on envoy-internal. Messages stay in the SQLite cache for 12 hours.
steps.scene: a paper plane carrying a bell

steps.title: Subscribe
steps.text: Subscribers hold a stream open with a keepalive every 45 seconds. iOS wake-ups go through the upstream relay at ntfy.sh.

steps.title: Attach
steps.text: Attachments expire after 24 hours, with a 50 MB limit per file and 1 GB in total, under the cache directory.
steps.scene: a file in a glowing tray

steps.title: Keep
steps.text: The auth database under /var/lib/ntfy and the cache under /var/cache/ntfy share claim ntfy, which kopiur backs up.
